scope: SHA-256 inventory of provisioned deployment files; all listed files match the retained local model store. A stored checkpoint or pack is not by itself evidence of an enabled language or custom training.
availability: Model weights, adapter arrays and dictionaries are separately provisioned; this file contains identities only.
export_lineage: The historical export manifest records pack identities, but not a source-checkpoint hash for each pack; checkpoint-to-run matches and deployed-pack hashes are recorded separately.
